rationale: The new task closely matches the tested relay: Guion’s example validates HMAC signatures, stores event state in SQLite, retries delivery, and reports dead letters. Both implementations passed the acceptance checks, while Guion had much lower measured time for the matching frozen case. Python’s implementation was more compact, which could make future changes easier.
trial_observation: The acceptance run passed all 9 cases for both implementations: 98/98 checks each. Across 7 trials of the named frozen case, median time was 0.144264 s for Guion and 0.818263 s for Python. Those measurements include process and oracle-check time, exclude fixture setup, and apply to this case rather than predicting general performance.
